title: Danny Welbeck prepares for Brighton reunion at Chelsea
seoTitle: Danny Welbeck prepares for Brighton reunion at Chelsea
subtitle: Striker scored on his debut and looks forward to a special Premier League clash
excerpt: Danny Welbeck looks forward to facing Brighton with Chelsea after scoring on his debut. Manager Xabi Alonso praises the veteran's impact on the squad.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Striker Danny Welbeck is trending in searches as he prepares for the Premier League clash between Chelsea and Brighton. The 35-year-old player will face his former team after transferring during the European summer and scoring on his debut for his new club.

A goalscoring debut and quick adaptation

Welbeck had a positive start to his journey at Chelsea, scoring a header in the 2-0 victory over Luton Town in the English League Cup. The athlete highlighted that the transition was eased by the warm welcome from fans, coaching staff, and new teammates, as well as the presence of familiar faces at the club.

A special reunion with Brighton

The next fixture puts the striker up against Brighton, a club he represented for six seasons before transferring to Stamford Bridge. Manager Xabi Alonso admitted relief to have the veteran on his side for this match, highlighting the positive track record the player had built against the Blues in previous encounters.

Leadership and influence in training

In addition to Welbeck, the arrival of experienced players like Jordan Henderson helped add leadership to the squad managed by Xabi Alonso. The Spanish coach pointed out that the striker's daily dedication raises training standards and makes a decisive contribution to the group.

Ambitious projections for the season

With a squad considered balanced and bolstered by several signings, Danny Welbeck expressed confidence that the club has enough quality to build something special this season. The team continues to work patiently to assimilate the manager's new tactical instructions and seek positive results on the weekends.

With information from Chelsea Football Club, Goal.com, roundtable.io.
